scenario: pod creations are refused; the webhook fails closed because its certificate expired
query: why does the checkout rollout not start in shop
mechanism: the injector's serving certificate expired at T0 and was not renewed (its issuer mesh-ca is gone), so the API server's calls to the webhook fail TLS verification, and the webhook, set to failurePolicy Fail, rejects every pod creation in shop
pass_if: names the expired certificate, or the webhook failing closed because of it
partial_if_only: a webhook rejects the pods, without why
